title: A Benchmark for Understanding Dialogue Safety in Mental Health Support

bias_targets.methodology: Evaluated via a text classification task where models (such as ChatGPT, BERT, and RoBERTa) predict whether a model-generated dialogue response falls into the 'Toxic Language' safety category, which the authors explicitly define as encompassing racism and social bias.

Evaluated through text classification to detect 'Nonfactual Statements', identifying instances where conversational agents express subjective opinions influenced by their inherent biases and preferences rather than providing objective facts.
